review_locator: PMCID:PMC3612391, The role and mechanism-of-action of Sema3E and Plexin-D1 in vascular and neural development; PMCID:PMC3081170, Semaphorins and their receptors: Novel features of neural guidance molecules
primary_title: Semaphorin 3E and plexin-D1 control vascular pattern independently of neuropilins; Semaphorin 3E initiates antiangiogenic signaling through plexin D1 by regulating Arf6 and R-Ras
decision_basis: The reviews identify PLXND1 as the direct, neuropilin-independent receptor for SEMA3E; primary vascular and endothelial studies show direct receptor binding, genetic dependence, and repulsive/antiangiogenic function.
limitations_preserved: Preserve direct neuropilin-independent PLXND1 topology, furin-processed SEMA3E/p61 ligand form where applicable, vascular/endothelial context, and no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3081170, Semaphorins and their receptors: Novel features of neural guidance molecules; PMCID:PMC4980550, Plexin activation review
primary_title: Dual roles of Sema6D in cardiac morphogenesis through region-specific association of its receptor, Plexin-A1, with off-track and vascular endothelial growth factor receptor type 2; Hybrid in vitro/in silico analysis of low-affinity protein-protein interactions that regulate signal transduction by Sema6D
decision_basis: The reviews identify PLXNA1 as a major direct SEMA6D receptor; primary cardiac-development and structural biophysical studies show selective PLXNA1 binding and receptor-dependent morphogenetic/guidance function.
limitations_preserved: Preserve membrane/soluble SEMA6D ectodomain and region-specific OTK/VEGFR2 co-receptor context; PLXNA1 is the direct binding receptor, but additional partners shape function; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6920667, Structural biology of the TGFbeta family; PMCID:PMC7797196, Structure-guided engineering of TGF-betas
primary_title: Ternary complex of transforming growth factor-beta1 reveals isoform-specific ligand recognition and receptor recruitment in the superfamily
decision_basis: The reviews identify the TGF-beta receptor heterotetramer as a dimeric ligand with two type-I and two type-II receptors; the primary crystal structure directly resolves human TGF-beta1 with TGFBR1 and TGFBR2 ectodomains.
limitations_preserved: Preserve mature dimeric TGF-beta1, latent-complex activation boundary, 2:2:2 ligand/receptor stoichiometry, and type-II-first assembly semantics; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6920667, Structural biology of the TGFbeta family; PMCID:PMC6800142, Specificity, versatility and control of TGF-beta family signaling
primary_title: Crystal structure of the human TbetaR2 ectodomain--TGF-beta3 complex
decision_basis: The reviews identify TGFBR2 as the high-affinity initial receptor for TGF-beta isoforms; the primary study resolves the human TGFBR2 ectodomain bound to homodimeric TGF-beta3 and maps the binary interface.
limitations_preserved: Binary TGF-beta3-TGFBR2 binding only; the complete TGFBR1-containing signaling complex is a separate assembly layer, and no SCI or terminal-TF inference is added.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6920667, Structural biology of the TGFbeta family; PMID:15449706, BMP/receptor molecular-recognition review
primary_title: Structure of the ternary signaling complex of a TGF-beta superfamily member
decision_basis: The reviews identify BMP2 type-I/type-II receptor assembly as a complete ternary signaling complex; the primary crystal structure resolves BMP2 with BMPR1A and ACVR2A ectodomains in a symmetric receptor assembly.
limitations_preserved: Preserve BMP2 homodimer and noncontacting type-I/type-II ectodomain assembly; ACVR2A is the assayed type-II receptor, and no SCI or terminal-TF inference is added.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6587955, Bone morphogenetic protein receptor signal transduction in human disease; PMCID:PMC6920667, Structural biology of the TGFbeta family
primary_title: Specificity and Structure of a High Affinity Activin Receptor-like Kinase 1 (ALK1) Signaling Complex
decision_basis: The reviews identify ALK1/ACVRL1 with ActRIIB/ACVR2B as a high-affinity BMP9 receptor complex; the primary study resolves the fully assembled BMP9-ALK1-ActRIIB ternary structure and receptor-selective binding.
limitations_preserved: Preserve BMP9 homodimer, endothelial ALK1 preference, ACVR2B high-affinity type-II context, and ectodomain structural boundary; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6587955, Bone morphogenetic protein receptor signal transduction in human disease; PMCID:PMC6920667, Structural biology of the TGFbeta family
primary_title: Crystal structures of BMPRII extracellular domain in binary and ternary receptor complexes with BMP10
decision_basis: The reviews identify BMP10 as an ALK1 ligand using type-II receptors including BMPRII; the primary study resolves BMP10-BMPRII binary complexes and the complete ALK1:BMP10:BMPRII signaling complex.
limitations_preserved: Preserve BMP10 dimer, low-affinity BMPRII/ALK1 assembly and pulmonary-endothelial context; do not transfer ACVR2A/ACVR2B specificity or infer SCI/terminal-TF output.
